block.confirm_message:
You will no longer be able to exchange messages, your conversation will disappear from your inbox and you will no longer see each other in searches or ads.

This person is not notified. If you share a Band Space, nothing changes there: only its admin can remove a member.

You can unblock them at any time from your settings, in the "Privacy" section.
